name: El Hoyo Maravilla, East Los Angeles, 1983
note: Black-and-white group portrait of seven young men against a brick wall, in pleated trousers, cropped sweatpants, white tees, belts, hairnets and Converse. Attributed from style and period to Beckman's 1983 El Hoyo Maravilla series. I found no source that captions this exact image.
